description: Upload a local file and submit it to an assignment in one step. Your instructor sees it and it counts as a submission attempt. To upload now and submit later, use upload_submission_file. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

comment.description: Comment text, visible to your instructor.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the local file

name: submit_assignment_file
title: Submit Assignment File
